title: Logos 35 opening: testimonies: Son begotten, not made — SERIES
english: Thirty-fifth discourse. Scriptural testimonies that the Son is begotten from the Father and not made.
Wisdom, Psalms, and John lemmas close the Thesaurus: eternal generation, not fabrication. THESAURUS SERIES CLOSEOUT.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Condensed lemma-led tip.
No Greystone wording. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
